subject: 2018 MCAS Strategic Analysis
overview: The Medford School Committee received strategic analysis presentations on 2018 MCAS test results and curriculum planning across Mathematics, Science, and ELA, as well as a briefing on upcoming MBTA road closures. The committee also approved donations, scholarships, commencement plans, and the 2019–2020 school year calendar.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the March 6, 2019 meeting as amended.

items.title: Approval of Bills and Transfer of Funds
items.summary: Approved the payment of bills and transfer of funds following committee questions regarding busing costs and universal screening fees.

items.title: Report on Upcoming MBTA Road Closures
items.summary: Received a presentation on upcoming Green Line Extension bridge closures, detours, and bus route modifications affecting student drop-offs and pedestrian safety.

items.title: Donation to McGlynn Middle School
items.summary: Approved a $500 donation from Medford Engineering and Survey to fund prizes for the McGlynn Middle School Mustang Way contest.

items.title: Curtis Tufts High School Scholarship Approval
items.summary: Approved the establishment of an ongoing $500 scholarship for trade or technical post-secondary education for a Curtis Tufts High School senior.

items.title: Commencement Exercises Approval
items.summary: Approved holding commencement exercises for the Medford High School Class of 2019 at Tufts University on June 5, 2019.

items.title: 2019–2020 School Year Calendar Approval
items.summary: Approved the 2019–2020 school calendar with requests to publish key dates and estimated last days online for parents.

items.title: Special Education Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Accepted the report from the February 5, 2019 Special Education Subcommittee meeting regarding out-of-school programs and disability awareness.

items.title: Report of the Superintendent
items.summary: Presented district updates including a security shelter-in-place at Roberts Elementary, Black History Month events, Pi Day, and student athletic accomplishments.

items.title: 2018 Mathematics MCAS Strategic Analysis
items.summary: Presented district performance data on the 2018 Math MCAS, after which the committee voted to request detailed assessment reports broken down by school and standard.

items.title: 2018 Science MCAS Strategic Analysis
items.summary: Accepted a report on 2018 Science MCAS results and updates on the rollout of the FOSS curriculum across elementary grades.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: Passed resolutions expressing condolences to the families of Dorothy Palladino, Anthony Staffier, and Phyllis Louise McCormick.

items.title: 2018 ELA MCAS Strategic Analysis
items.summary: Accepted a detailed report on 2018 English Language Arts MCAS performance, technology challenges with online testing, and targeted instructional shifts.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining negotiations and legal matters.
